title: Grateful Dead Live at Dean Smith Center - University of North Carolina on 1993-03-25
venue: Dean Smith Center - University of North Carolina
lineage: Tascam DA-30 -[S/PDIF]-> (48k) Diamond xTreme SC > Cool Edit Pro (44.1k) > CDWave > FLAC (L8)

ai_review.summary: Clear, high‑fidelity capture of a magical, energetic Dead show.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance, calling it terrific and describing an unmatched energy that made the concert unforgettable. The recording is praised for its clarity—especially when compared to a previous 48 kHz version—making the experience vivid and enjoyable. No specific song or band‑member details are mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5 stars and highlight a great show plus clear audio, but only two brief comments limit confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clearer than the earlier 48 kHz release; listeners note improved clarity and overall good sound quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers focus on the show's unique energy and personal significance, without commenting on pacing or song order.
